decisions: After any change to the update feed, download the feed from a clean Mac and confirm it lists the latest version.
Turn off the default empty file setting in the storage service.
A job runs every hour, and if the versions don't match for more than an hour, it posts to the team channel.
Add one line about it to the next release notes, and no separate announcement.
action_items: Daniel adds the feed check step to the release checklist today.
Tessa turns off the default empty file setting this afternoon, and Aman reviews it.
Aman builds the hourly feed check by the end of next week.
Karen writes the line for the release notes.
not_items: I want to understand why the old address answered at all.
Shouldn't it have returned an error?
So about six hours. How many people were affected?
Which is worse than an error, because nothing looked wrong.
